The '''Talvaria system''' was located in the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the group known as [[Talvarian]]s.<ref name="SL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The "Talvor [[Star system/Legends|system]],"<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> in reference to the Talvarian group,<ref name="SL" /> was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article written by [[Glen Allison]] as a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine. The placed the [[Star/Legends|star]] system in the [[Mahrusha sector/Legends|Mahrusha sector]]<ref name="Twinkle" /> and is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], named the system that was the origin point of the Talvarians "Talvaria" and placed it in grid square S-7.<ref name="TEA" />
